authority: quality override for corrected_transcription/README.json coverage checkpoint
rule: Coverage progress and transcription quality are separate. A page being processed or marked substantive does not certify literal, citation-ready transcription.

Mss23.note: Generally conservative and fragment-preserving, but not diplomatic transcription. Exact quotation requires manuscript-image verification.

problems: literal manuscript readings mixed with editorial reconstruction
diagram interpretation mixed into transcription field
normalized technical prose sometimes presented as source text
editorial English image-description terms entered secure_anchors
allowed_use_before_cleanup: provisional numerical anchors subject to image control
Mss24.resume_instruction: Do not continue the old mixed schema. First calibrate the corrected layered schema on a small mixed batch, recommended PDFs 56-60, then continue PDF 66 onward.

Mss25.note: The controlled Sheffield/Bessemer cluster, especially PDFs 295-300, is closer to the desired selective-transcription standard but still requires image control before exact quotation.

secure_anchor_rule: secure_anchors may derive only from literal_transcription and diagram_labels, never from editorial_description or normalized_entities
